response.sql:
WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT 
    f.feerate,
    f.rebrate,
    f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate,
    o.mktnote
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) AS overall_avg
  FROM matched_fees
  WHERE net_fee_rate IS NOT NULL
),
pair_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    mktnote,
    AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM matched_fees
  WHERE net_fee_rate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mktnote
),
qualifying_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.avg_net_fee_rate,
    pa.avg_net_fee_rate - oa.overall_avg AS excess
  FROM pair_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND pa.avg_net_fee_rate > oa.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_of_average_net_fee_rates,
  AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_above_overall
FROM qualifying_pairs
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

assumptions.assumption: NULL mktnote values are grouped together as a single trading pair, consistent with treating 'records lacking a pair' as one group. Output contains only the two computed aggregates; the pair identities are not returned.
